files.role: Package metadata and dependency declarations: fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, pydantic
Container image definition — python:3.12-slim, copies /platform_packages from repo root build context, sets PYTHONPATH, installs pyproject.toml deps, runs uvicorn on port 8000
Docker Compose service definition for label-engine: port 127.0.0.1:8050:8000, ATLAS_PG_* env vars, DATA_ROOT log volume mount, atlas-net network
Connection pool management and schema initialization for the labels schema in the shared Postgres instance

public_objects.name: init_pool
public_objects.purpose: Initialize the psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool (1–5 connections) using ATLAS_PG_* environment variables, with RealDictCursor.

public_objects.name: init_schema
public_objects.purpose: Create labels schema tables idempotently: tries sprint-folder schema.sql first, falls back to _inline_ddl(). Creates labels.labels and labels.object_labels tables with indexes.

public_objects.name: get_db
public_objects.purpose: Context manager that yields a connection from the pool; rolls back and re-raises on exception, always returns connection to pool.

public_objects.name: DATABASE_URL
public_objects.purpose: Module-level DSN string constructed at import time from ATLAS_PG_* env vars or DATABASE_URL override.

private_objects.name: _build_url
private_objects.purpose: Construct Postgres DSN from DATABASE_URL override or ATLAS_PG_* environment variables.

private_objects.name: _inline_ddl
private_objects.purpose: Return inline DDL string for labels.labels and labels.object_labels tables with all required indexes — used as fallback when sprint schema.sql is absent.

private_objects.name: _pool
private_objects.purpose: Module-level pool instance, None until init_pool() is called.

files.role: Pydantic data models for request bodies, response shapes, and internal data types used across routers and service

public_objects.name: LabelRecord
public_objects.purpose: Shared label row shape used in search results, creation responses, and reverse-lookup results.

public_objects.name: ObjectLabelRecord
public_objects.purpose: Single attachment row returned by attach and get-labels-for-object endpoints. attached_at is ISO-8601.

public_objects.name: GroupItem
public_objects.purpose: One object in a grouped query result — carries its primary label and full label list.

public_objects.name: LabelGroup
public_objects.purpose: One group in a grouped query result — label name and all objects belonging to it.

public_objects.name: GroupedMeta
public_objects.purpose: Pagination metadata for grouped query responses.

public_objects.name: LabelSearchResponse
public_objects.purpose: Response envelope for label search and reverse-lookup endpoints.

public_objects.name: ObjectLabelsResponse
public_objects.purpose: Response envelope for GET /api/objects/{object_id}/labels.

public_objects.name: GroupedObjectsResponse
public_objects.purpose: Response envelope for GET /api/groups.

public_objects.name: CreateLabelRequest
public_objects.purpose: Request body for POST /api/labels.

public_objects.name: AttachLabelRequest
public_objects.purpose: Request body for POST /api/objects/{object_id}/labels. object_type must be lowercase (enforced by DB CHECK).

public_objects.name: BatchLabelRecord
public_objects.purpose: One label entry in a batch response. attached_at is ISO-8601.

public_objects.name: BatchLabelsRequest
public_objects.purpose: Request body for POST /api/objects/labels/batch.

public_objects.name: BatchLabelsResponse
public_objects.purpose: Response for batch label read — keyed by object_id, zero-filled for IDs with no labels.

files.role: All label business logic: search, create, attach, remove, get-for-object, batch-read, grouped-query with primary-label resolution. No HTTP concerns.

public_objects.name: LabelEngineError
public_objects.purpose: Domain exception raised by LabelService for known failure modes (NOT_FOUND, etc.). Carries HTTP status for router translation.

public_objects.name: LabelService

methods.name: search_labels
methods.purpose: Case-insensitive prefix search on label name. Empty q returns all labels ordered by name.

methods.name: create_label
methods.purpose: Insert a new label row and return the created record.

methods.name: attach_label
methods.purpose: Resolve or create label by name (case-insensitive), then idempotently attach to object_id. Returns the canonical attachment row.

methods.name: remove_label
methods.purpose: Delete (object_id, label_id) attachment. Raises LabelEngineError LABEL_NOT_FOUND (404) or ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND (404) if absent.

methods.name: get_labels_for_object
methods.purpose: Return all labels attached to object_id ordered by attached_at ASC, label_id ASC.

methods.name: get_grouped_objects
methods.purpose: Paginate the flat ordered object list then group by primary label. Primary label = MIN(attached_at) with label_id ASC tiebreaker. Named groups sorted alphabetically; Unlabeled appended last.

methods.name: get_labels_for_objects
methods.purpose: Batch read: return labels for multiple object_ids filtered by object_type in one ANY(%s) query. Result is zero-filled — every requested object_id appears as a key.

methods.name: get_labels_used_by_type
methods.purpose: Return all distinct labels attached to at least one object of object_type, ordered by lower(name) ascending. Returns empty list if none.

public_objects.purpose: Stateless service class instantiated per-router. All methods receive an explicit DB connection.

private_objects.name: _resolve_or_create_label
private_objects.purpose: Case-insensitive exact match on label name; returns existing label_id or inserts a new label and returns the generated id.

files.role: FastAPI application entrypoint: app construction, CORS middleware, platform_errorhandling integration (optional import), router mounting, startup hook, health endpoint

public_objects.name: app
public_objects.purpose: FastAPI application instance. Mounts labels, objects, and groups routers under /api prefix. Configures CORS for localhost dev origins.

private_objects.name: health
private_objects.purpose: GET /health — returns {status: ok} when the service is running.

private_objects.name: on_startup
private_objects.purpose: FastAPI startup event handler — calls init_pool() then init_schema(). Logs errors but does not abort startup to allow DB-unavailable degraded state.

files.role: Label search, creation, and reverse-lookup routes: GET /api/labels/used, GET /api/labels, POST /api/labels

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter instance mounted by main.py under /api prefix.

private_objects.name: _api_error
private_objects.purpose: Construct JSONResponse with ApiError shape: {error: {code, message, detail, request_id}}.

private_objects.name: get_labels_used
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/labels/used — return distinct labels for given object_type. 422 OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED if absent or blank.

private_objects.name: search_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/labels?q= — case-insensitive prefix search; empty q returns all labels.

private_objects.name: create_label
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/labels — create new label; 422 LABEL_NAME_EMPTY if blank after strip; returns LabelRecord 201.

files.role: Label attachment, removal, per-object retrieval, and batch-read routes: POST /api/objects/labels/batch, POST /api/objects/{object_id}/labels, DELETE /api/objects/{object_id}/labels/{label_id}, GET /api/objects/{object_id}/labels

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter instance mounted by main.py under /api prefix.

private_objects.name: _api_error
private_objects.purpose: Construct JSONResponse with ApiError shape: {error: {code, message, detail, request_id}}.

private_objects.name: batch_labels
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/objects/labels/batch — return labels for up to 200 object_ids. 422 BATCH_TOO_LARGE, 422 OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED, zero-fill for IDs with no labels.

private_objects.name: attach_label
private_objects.purpose: POST /api/objects/{object_id}/labels — attach label by name; creates label inline if absent; idempotent; 422 for empty name/type; 422 OBJECT_TYPE_INVALID for non-lowercase type.

private_objects.name: remove_label
private_objects.purpose: DELETE /api/objects/{object_id}/labels/{label_id} — remove attachment; 404 ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND or 404 LABEL_NOT_FOUND if absent.

private_objects.name: get_object_labels
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/objects/{object_id}/labels — return all labels attached to object_id ordered by attached_at ASC.

files.role: Grouped object query route: GET /api/groups — returns objects grouped by primary label for a given object_type with pagination

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter instance mounted by main.py under /api prefix.

private_objects.name: _api_error
private_objects.purpose: Construct JSONResponse with ApiError shape: {error: {code, message, detail, request_id}}.

private_objects.name: get_grouped_objects
private_objects.purpose: GET /api/groups?object_type=&page=&page_size= — 422 OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED if absent; clamps page/page_size to minimum 1; delegates to LabelService.get_grouped_objects.
